Pharmacopoeias. In Chin., Eur. (see p.vii), Int., Jpn, US, and Viet. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Gentamicin Sulphate). A mixture of the sulfates of antimicrobial substances produced by Micromonospora purpu- rea, the main components being gentamicins C1, C1a, C2, C2a, and C2b. It contains 20 to 40% of gentamicin C1, 10 to 30% of gentamicin C1a; the sum of gentamicins C2, C2a, and C2b is 40 to 60%. The potency is not less than 590 units/mg, calculated with reference to the anhydrous substance. A white or almost white hygroscopic powder. Freely soluble in water; practically insoluble in alcohol.
